headline: Nifty companies report 22% earnings growth in Q2
hook: Nifty earnings growth hits three-year high
summary: Thirty-five Nifty companies have reported a 22% year-on-year earnings growth for the second quarter, marking the strongest performance in 12 quarters. The BFSI and metals sectors emerged as the key contributors to this outperformance. This trend indicates robust underlying profitability for India's largest listed corporations.

This heightened volatility means retail investors holding the stock may experience sharper near-term price movements than the Nifty 50. Such fluctuations require close risk management for those with active positions in the steel sector.

headline: JSW Steel completes amalgamation of Piombino Steel
summary: JSW Steel Limited has informed the stock exchange that the scheme of amalgamation involving Piombino Steel Limited and its shareholders has officially taken effect. Piombino Steel is now merged into JSW Steel following the completion of statutory and procedural formalities. For JSW Steel shareholders, this internal corporate restructuring consolidates steel assets under the main listed entity. Retail investors track such mergers for potential impact on consolidated debt, asset base, and future earnings reporting.
whats_next: Consolidated financial reporting reflecting the merger in upcoming quarters
why_it_matters: Consolidated assets alter the company's financial structure over time
